label: Crystalized ball
desc: A faceted crystal sphere of flat voronoi facets with per-facet lighting and glints that turns slowly and leans toward the pointer.
use: Hero accent or feature visual (centred in its parent, which it fills; sphere fits the smaller side).

label: Cubes
desc: A field of CSS 3D cubes that flip as the pointer sweeps over them and tilt toward it, with a slow wave and self-flips for touch.
use: Behind a hero or as a playful empty-state backdrop (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Dither veil
desc: A drifting noise veil quantised through an ordered 8x8 dither into crisp brand-coloured dots, densest on one edge and thinning around the pointer.
use: Overlay on a hero or card edge to fade content into texture (transparent canvas; fills its parent, put above the backdrop and below the text).

label: Elastic mesh
desc: A grid of spring-linked nodes that stretches toward the pointer, wobbles back, and can be plucked by press or tap.
use: Behind a hero or playful section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Electric border
desc: Wraps any content in a crackling electric arc that runs around its rounded edge.
use: Around a featured card, pricing tier or call-to-action (wraps its children; set radius to match).

label: Electric logo
desc: Electric arcs and sparks crackle around the outline of a mark; supply your own SVG path or SVG children (a neutral gem mark is the default).
use: Hero brand mark, loading screen or footer sign-off; pass path="M..." or SVG shapes as children.

label: Laser flow
desc: Volumetric laser beams sweeping across a dark stage with pulses running down each beam and a soft haze; beams lean with the pointer.
use: Dark hero or event/launch section background (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Meta balls
desc: Gooey blobs drift on looping paths and fuse where they meet, with a lit rim; the pointer carries an extra blob.
use: Behind a hero or loading state (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Metallic paint
desc: A pool of liquid chrome: a warped height field lit as a mirror reflecting a brand-tinted studio, with a thin-film sheen; the pointer dents it.
use: Hero panel, brand card or banner background (fills its parent).

label: Ribbons
desc: Soft tapered ribbons that trail the pointer on springs, or swim on looping paths when idle or on touch.
use: Behind a hero or as a cursor-follow accent (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Ripple distortion
desc: A picture seen through water: pointer movement, clicks and taps send rings across it that bend and split the light.
use: Hero image or feature visual; pass src for your picture (fills its parent), or leave it out for the built-in pattern.

label: Strands
desc: A bundle of fine threads that braid and pinch as they flow across the box and part around the pointer.
use: Behind a hero, divider band or footer (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).
